tags.name: sn-resource
tags.description: a named, page-wide cache of server data; `cache` (or `cache="10m"`) shows the data from the last page load at once, then revalidates. `early="off"`: never preloaded or requested before the page module (for a resource a request middleware answers itself; one whose request a middleware changes, such as a token, needs nothing: the build and runtime handle it). With `sinter({ apis })`, `src` is a path relative to an API (`/articles`, `billing:/invoices`); `method="POST"` with `body` loads with a POST of that value. `src="file:./intro.txt"` (`file:/…` from the root) reads the project at build time (text, JSON, markdown's frontmatter and `body`; a glob: a list with `slug`, `dir`, `path`), a constant (`order`, `drafts`; `fields="slug,title"`: only those fields of each entry ship to the browser, which a `content:` collection that browser code reads needs). Loading needs no attributes: concurrent loads of one URL share a request, a `src` change aborts the running one (latest wins), a change typed into a text field waits 250 ms for the next keystroke, a resource only dialogs read is requested with low priority, and a bfcache restore or going back online reloads⟪FULL⟫, and Back or Forward to a page the bfcache lost shows what it showed as it was left (with or without `cache`), then revalidates⟪SHORT⟫⟪END⟫. `paginate="{ keyset: { before: $item.id }, size: 20 }"` loads a page at a time (`append`, `numbered: true`; `model: $url.page` keeps a numbered list's page in the URL; `jump`, `params`, `directions`, also per API)

tags.name: sn-component
tags.description: a component chosen by data at runtime; `use` names it: ``use="`${b.type}-block`"`` (convention), `use="{ hero: 'hero-block' }[b.type]"` (map) or `use="blockComponent(b)"` (helper); it must fit `ComponentName`, every candidate must exist, props are checked per candidate (narrowed for convention and map); a value outside the candidates renders nothing, or the `data-sn-else` template after it; `data-sn-early="off"` leaves it out of the early script

tags.name: sn-event
tags.description: maps one server event to a change message; child of <sn-sync>. `then`: a handler run after the change

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-state
globalAttributes.description: declares local reactive state for the element and its subtree (object literal)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-let
globalAttributes.description: derived names for the element and its subtree, computed where they are read (a helper call included: keep an expensive one's results with `memo()`, configuration.md); later names may use earlier ones (object literal {name: expression})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-text
globalAttributes.description: sets textContent (null and undefined: empty, no `?? ''` needed); never HTML. On a <template>: a text node with no element (a run of text beside elements); no other attribute on that template (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-attr
globalAttributes.description: literal keys; null/false removes, true sets empty; URL values are checked; checked, selected, indeterminate and value also set the live property (object literal {href: …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-href
globalAttributes.description: on <a>, <area>: the link; may also start with ? or # (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-class
globalAttributes.description: toggles each class (object literal {unread: …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-style
globalAttributes.description: sets each property with style.setProperty (object literal {'--color': …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-show
globalAttributes.description: toggles the hidden attribute (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-prefetch
globalAttributes.description: on <html>: no other page prefetches this one's data or the page itself (Speculation Rules), and none prerenders it; for pages that do something when they load (off)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-permanent
globalAttributes.description: with sinter({ swap }): kept as is (playing, scrolled) across a link to a page with the name; its bindings go on (name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-swap
globalAttributes.description: on <html>: links here load it; on a link: it loads its page (off)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-transition
globalAttributes.description: the same thing on two pages: following a link from the element (or its row) to a page with an element of the same name morphs one into the other (view transitions; back too) (value expression (a name))

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-with
globalAttributes.description: sets JS properties; custom elements only (also one defined later). On a component's tag: its props, live and read-only. On a <slot> declared Slot<T>: the values its fill reads as $slot; on a named <slot> its component does not declare, a tree placement, filled by the nearest enclosing component declaring the name (object literal)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-props
globalAttributes.description: the props a component or a layout takes, a TypeScript type literal, { article: Article; compact?: boolean }. On the <template> of a component file (src/components/<name>.html, or a component library's components/): a member cell: Slot<{ row: Row }> is a slot that passes data to its fill; its root renders at most one element (one element, a data-sn-if/data-sn-else chain of them, a component, <sn-component use> or a <slot>), or, a head component, any number of head elements (<title>, <meta>, <link>, …), inlined at its use in a head. On the <html> of a layout file (src/layouts/<name>.html): a page that is only the layout's tag fills its slots, in the head and the body. Either leaves it out when it takes no props (props type)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-early
globalAttributes.description: on a component's tag (a use): this use is left out of the early script and renders when the page module runs (build-time constants stay in the HTML); keeps the early script small (off)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-import
globalAttributes.description: loads packages of sinter({ lazy }) when the element is rendered (at takeover outside templates, when its branch or row first renders inside one), instead of on first call (lazy packages, comma-separated)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-wait
globalAttributes.description: on a box whose width follows its content (a flex item without a basis or width, a float) around a list over late data: what follows the box stays invisible while the list's first rows load (at most 3 s), so nothing shown moves when they widen it (builds, at the widths where it is so); off shows it, and SN529 says it moves (off)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-preload
globalAttributes.description: the build preloads packages of sinter({ lazy }) with the page (<link rel="modulepreload">): fetched with the page bundle, run on first call or by data-sn-import (lazy packages, comma-separated)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-ref
globalAttributes.description: in a component's markup: the element its script reads as this.refs.<name>, typed by its tag (name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-emits
globalAttributes.description: on the <template data-sn-props>: the events emit() sends and their detail types, e.g. { select: Article } (events type)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-model
globalAttributes.description: two-way binding for form controls; on $url, the URL follows (a history entry; typing at each pause), and a <select multiple> or a checkbox with a value makes the parameter a list (state path | $url.<param>)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-model-debounce
globalAttributes.description: delays the model's write until typing pauses (no second pause after it); Enter writes at once (duration)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-for
globalAttributes.description: repeats a <template> per item. On <html>: the page once per entry of a `file:` list, at `data-sn-path` filled from it (item in list | (item, i) in list)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-key
globalAttributes.description: row identity; inferred: resource key, object identity or value (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-if
globalAttributes.description: renders a <template> while truthy. Same id, same control: when a branch swaps, the element with an id in the new one takes the old one's focus and running action (a toggle: <button id="f" data-sn-delete=…>, <button id="f" data-sn-post=…>) (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-else
globalAttributes.description: on a

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-options
globalAttributes.description: arrows mark a [role=option|menuitem] of the list (empty: inside the element, else the nearest listbox or menu), Enter clicks it, Escape fires `sn-dismiss`; focus stays on the element. Text field: a combobox (id of the list, or empty)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-persist
globalAttributes.description: persists the model or state in localStorage under sn: (storage key)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-post
globalAttributes.description: POST action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-put
globalAttributes.description: PUT action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-patch
globalAttributes.description: PATCH action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-delete
globalAttributes.description: DELETE action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-call
globalAttributes.description: local action: a function of the actions module, e.g. pgp.decrypt(msg); a handler starts it with run('id'). The function gets a trailing context; its `ctx.request(url, { method, body })` encodes `body` as JSON: pass the object, not `JSON.stringify(…)` (a string) (action call)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-body
globalAttributes.description: JSON request body; overrides form serialization (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-trigger
globalAttributes.description: overrides the default trigger (DOM event name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-debounce
globalAttributes.description: delays the action's trigger, resets on each event (duration)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-concurrency
globalAttributes.description: what a trigger does while the action runs; default block for forms, queue otherwise (block | queue | latest)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-optimistic
globalAttributes.description: merge/upsert/remove calls applied before the request, kept on success, rolled back on failure (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-then
globalAttributes.description: runs after a 2xx response; $result = parsed body (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-catch
globalAttributes.description: runs after an error; $error = {status, body, message, detail}. A form without it shows a 4xx `{errors: {name: message}}` on its fields (aria-invalid and the message); its markup reads the failure as `$error` (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-confirm
globalAttributes.description: asks this question before the action runs (configure({ confirm }), window.confirm by default); no question when falsy (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-encoding
globalAttributes.description: the body (data-sn-body, arrays as repeated keys, or the form) goes as application/x-www-form-urlencoded (form)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-retry
globalAttributes.description: sends the request again (with data-sn-call: each request ctx.request sends) as that policy of configure({ retry }) says (after a network error, a 5xx, a 429), with an Idempotency-Key; without it a write is sent once (retry policy name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-write-through
globalAttributes.description: turns write-through off for this mutation: its response is not applied to the resources it is about (off)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-path
globalAttributes.description: on <html>: the path shapes this page is served for; `:name` segments appear read-only in $url (URL patterns /a/:b …)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-resource
globalAttributes.description: on <script type="application/json"> in <head>: initial data for a resource (resource name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-click
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-input
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-change
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-submit
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown-escape
globalAttributes.description: runs only for that key (also on-keyup-<key>): modifiers first, the key last, e.g. data-sn-on-keydown-j, -shift-n (N), -mod-enter (Ctrl, Cmd on Apple), -escape, -question (?); matches KeyboardEvent.key; other Ctrl/Alt/Meta held do not match; an ancestor's filter skips keys typed into fields; a match calls preventDefault()

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown-enter
globalAttributes.description: runs only for that key (also on-keyup-<key>): modifiers first, the key last, e.g. data-sn-on-keydown-j, -shift-n (N), -mod-enter (Ctrl, Cmd on Apple), -escape, -question (?); matches KeyboardEvent.key; other Ctrl/Alt/Meta held do not match; an ancestor's filter skips keys typed into fields; a match calls preventDefault()

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown-arrowdown
globalAttributes.description: runs only for that key (also on-keyup-<key>): modifiers first, the key last, e.g. data-sn-on-keydown-j, -shift-n (N), -mod-enter (Ctrl, Cmd on Apple), -escape, -question (?); matches KeyboardEvent.key; other Ctrl/Alt/Meta held do not match; an ancestor's filter skips keys typed into fields; a match calls preventDefault()

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown-arrowup
globalAttributes.description: runs only for that key (also on-keyup-<key>): modifiers first, the key last, e.g. data-sn-on-keydown-j, -shift-n (N), -mod-enter (Ctrl, Cmd on Apple), -escape, -question (?); matches KeyboardEvent.key; other Ctrl/Alt/Meta held do not match; an ancestor's filter skips keys typed into fields; a match calls preventDefault()

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown-mod-enter
globalAttributes.description: runs only for that key (also on-keyup-<key>): modifiers first, the key last, e.g. data-sn-on-keydown-j, -shift-n (N), -mod-enter (Ctrl, Cmd on Apple), -escape, -question (?); matches KeyboardEvent.key; other Ctrl/Alt/Meta held do not match; an ancestor's filter skips keys typed into fields; a match calls preventDefault()

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-debounce-input
globalAttributes.description: delays only that event's data-sn-on-<event> handler (it runs with the last event); e.g. data-sn-debounce-input

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-debounce-keyup
globalAttributes.description: delays only that event's data-sn-on-<event> handler (it runs with the last event); e.g. data-sn-debounce-input

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-debounce-scroll
globalAttributes.description: delays only that event's data-sn-on-<event> handler (it runs with the last event); e.g. data-sn-debounce-input
